claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG020134 reports PEID 20134, display name Malays, country Malaysia and primary language Malay (zlm).
Glottolog identifies Central Malay with glottocode mala1479 and ISO 639-3 code zlm.

Scholarship on Malayness and Melayu describes multiple historical forms of Malay identity, while Malaysian language-policy research places Malay's national role within a broader multilingual and institutional setting; together these sources argue against collapsing language, legal/national category and personal identity into one timeless definition.
claims.interpretationNote: This synthesis preserves distinctions among language, institutional categories and personal identity and does not claim every Malay person understands identity in the same way.
